h2. Description

*Until a user changes them, Tech View should open on 13 set columns in a set order.* On staging a new user sees a different set and order.

For example,
* On Site, VIN/Serial # and Lead Technician are shown, though they should be off by default
* Waiting On Parts and Assigned Techs are missing
* Asset comes before Unit

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10045*) and the PRD.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as a brand-new Admin user who has never opened Tech View (no saved choices), at *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
#* The columns read: On Site, Status, Number, Customer, Asset, Unit, VIN/Serial #, Progress, Service Advisor, Lead Technician, Clocked In, Lines, Total Price, Created On.

*Actual Result:*
* Tech View opens on 14 columns that are not the PRD's default set or order.

*Expected Result:*
* Tech View opens on the 13 default columns, as the test expects: *"Step 2: there are 13 columns, in this order: Status, Waiting On Parts, Number, Customer, Unit, Asset, Progress, Service Advisor, Clocked In, Lines, Assigned Techs, Created on, Total price. On Site, VIN/Serial # and Lead Technician are not shown."*
